process.title: How does an order get delivered?
process.description: Four stages, cold chain all the way, and the driver calls before arriving. (Order before 4pm for next-working-day delivery.)

received.title: Order received
received.body: Once we receive your order we start preparing it right away. Our team picks every item, then sorts, checks and packs it so nothing is missing.

hub.title: Sent to the transport hub
hub.body: Every package travels by refrigerated truck to our transport hub, which has cold-room storage to keep products in top condition.

routed.title: Routed by area
routed.body: The hub sorts orders by delivery area and assigns drivers. Before setting off, the driver contacts the receiving person so someone is ready to accept the goods.

delivered.title: Delivered safely
delivered.body: When the goods arrive, please check them on the spot. If anything is damaged, missing or the quantity is wrong, WhatsApp our customer service right away and we'll sort it out.

customers.title: Who we serve
customers.description: From single outlets to small chains, and home cooks too.

about.title: About us
about.lead: LB Frozen Food Marketing is a family-run frozen food wholesaler in Sri Damansara, Kuala Lumpur, specialising in frozen seafood and food-service ingredients.
about.story1: We registered in 2005 and started with two people and one van, delivering fish balls to kopitiams. Twenty years on we have our own cold rooms and fleet, but the way we work hasn't changed: a real person answers the phone, we remember what our customers cook, and we deliver before they open.
about.story2: If something is out of stock, we tell you the same day and suggest a substitute. We'd rather sell one item less than have your kitchen find out at 6pm.

ordering.title: How to order
ordering.description: Businesses can order on WhatsApp for delivery; walk-in customers can buy at retail prices at our warehouse.

items.b1: Send us your order by WhatsApp or phone.
items.b2: For your first order we'll send our price list and set your delivery day.
items.b3: Order before 4pm for delivery the next working day.
items.b4: Minimum RM300 for delivery; no minimum for pickup.
items.b5: Walk-in customers: just come by during opening hours, no need to order ahead.

items.b2: Bank transfer to our company account.
items.b3: Regular customers can apply for 30-day credit terms.
items.b4: An invoice comes with every delivery.

items.b1: Fixed routes across the Klang Valley with regular weekly deliveries.
items.b2: Refrigerated trucks all the way, so goods arrive frozen.
items.b3: Please check goods on delivery and tell the driver about any problem.
items.b4: Damaged or thawed goods are replaced free of charge.
